expect class [GoogleCredentials](-google-credentials/index.html)

ADK-owned handle to Google Cloud credentials for Vertex AI (see [VertexCredentials](-vertex-credentials/index.html)). On JVM and Android it is a `typealias` for `com.google.auth.oauth2.GoogleCredentials`.
